QuestInfo.name: A Difference of Opinion
QuestInfo.0: The Snow Child and Bitsie will need more than just a single person in their corner if he ever hopes to be allowed back in the village. You and Bitsie try to persuade the villagers, but they are still concerned about the snow monster.
